payload.entry: Fixed plan propose inlet ordering in sase src/sase/main/plan_propose_handler.py: publish failure (InletError or any store/lock RuntimeError) and missing canonical ref now restore scratch from original and unlink archive with clear error, no gate/handoff. Added 2 regression tests in tests/test_plan_command_handler_formatting.py (InletError + RuntimeError rollback). Verified: 8 passed formatting suite, 24 passed plan handler + metadata suites (incl. successful links inlet archives), ruff check/format clean, mypy clean. Epic-symbols clean.

PLANNING: Audited B4 design, bob-cli-cv, closed sase-yo and sase-1oh.4; this phase had no prior work notes. At sase daf54c5b2d, failed-close reopening is landed but reset_replay still aborts before a HEAD-only snapshot, errors lose prior recovery refs, and stash-failure/reclone paths accept best-effort rescue without proof of dirty-content preservation. No source changes or historical reproduction claimed. Authored a four-phase child epic (verified snapshot, reset replay, relaunch cleanup, failed-close evidence) with parent_bead bob-cli-df.4; validated with --explain then revalidated, both pass with zero warnings. Submitting through sase plan propose; child land must verify full tracked/staged/untracked recovery and close df.4 only, leaving cv and df to B4 land.

Updated the protocol-1 catalog CLI test to expect 55 entries and assert the themes-split ID/path; cargo test --test cli catalog passed (20 passed), just fmt passed, and just check passed (3,774 unit tests, 2,319 CLI tests, integration targets; existing clippy warnings only). Epic symbols were clear before close.
